value.rationale: Quantifies rare departures from a natural neutral regime of a motivated piecewise-smooth economic dynamical model. Exact finite-horizon first-departure probabilities and a sharp arithmetic condition separate uniform quadratic convergence from arbitrarily slow subsequences; the finite survivor polygon and infinite survivor atom bridge finite transient observables and classical center geometry. Neither the observable nor the Diophantine iff is a routine renaming of the older polygon/ellipse existence theorem. The sharp boundary is reusable to assess near-center sojourn statistics.
